name: vb-framework-debug
description: Debug local VB.NET console and WinForms applications on the Windows desktop CLR.

program.description: Path to a built .NET Framework console or WinForms executable.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the executable's directory.

architecture.description: Debuggee architecture. Select x86 for an x86 or Prefer 32-bit executable.

sourceFileMap.description: Map absolute PDB source directory prefixes to local directories. Longest boundary-matched prefix wins; checksums must match.

expressionStringComparison.description: Explicitly select Option Compare Binary semantics for pure string comparisons. Omit to reject string comparisons rather than guess project settings.

diagnostics.description: Trace request names and stop/module transitions without variable values or launch arguments. Ordinary errors and module responses can still contain source paths.

processId.description: Numeric PID of a local .NET Framework process. Disconnect detaches by default.

architecture.description: Must match the selected process. Modern .NET/CoreCLR is not supported.

sourceFileMap.description: Map absolute PDB source directory prefixes to local directories; source checksums are verified.
